text: The founding D2NN was demonstrated by Lin et al. (2018) at UCLA using 3D-printed dielectric layers operating at terahertz frequencies.
explanation: True: Lin, Rivenson, Ozcan and colleagues (2018, Science) introduced the diffractive deep neural network using 3D-printed dielectric plates at terahertz, the founding demonstration of all-optical D2NN inference that organizes the whole chapter.
